author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: A recent Crowd Supply campaign features the Firehat, an open-source FireWire HAT designed for PCIe-capable single-board computers including the Raspberry Pi 5 and Radxa ROCK 2F. The board uses a VIA VT6315N IEEE 1394 controller and targets direct DV and HDV capture from older digital camcorders and tape decks using Linux. Developed by Computer Equipment […]
title: FireWire HAT with PCIe 2.0 for Tapeless DV and HDV Capture
